channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio faz dois gols contra, mas evita goleada de Lula na Globo
item.description: In a Globo debate, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied at 50% in valid votes from Datafolha. Flávio scored three goals, two against, avoiding a loss for his opponent but failing to surpass Lula.

item.title: Quem é Mariana? Janones associa exploração de mulheres a aliados de Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) associated Mariana Vishegirskaya, a Ukrainian woman photographed during the 2022 Mariupol maternity hospital bombing, with suspicions of refugee exploitation in Brazil, indirectly linking the case to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and his alleged ally Daniel Vorcaro, while denying any direct connection between the young woman and the candidate. He used the case to denounce potential sexual exploitation networks targeting Ukrainian refugees and called for investigations.

item.title: Manifestantes se concentram em Copacabana para ato pró-Lula
item.description: Supporters gathered at Copacabana Beach backing Lula's re-election, where he sharply criticized Flávio Bolsonaro following the TV Globo debate. Lula accused his opponent of dishonesty and evasiveness, emphasizing the need to occupy public spaces ahead of the runoff.

item.title: Leia o que a mídia internacional diz sobre o debate da “Globo”
item.description: International media highlighted the polarized debate between Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro, especially personal provocations like the 'nine fingers' comment. Outlets emphasized disagreements on economy and corruption, while criticism of Javier Milei was also noted by Argentine press.

item.title: Vitória de Flávio seria “desastre para todo o planeta”, diz Greta
item.description: Greta Thunberg stated that a victory by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) would be a 'disaster for the entire planet', emphasizing the impact of the Brazilian elections on the future of the Amazon and climate change. The environmental activist warned about the environmental consequences of a potential Flávio administration, particularly for the country's critical ecosystems.

item.title: Ex-ministros de Lula e Dilma declaram apoio a Flávio
item.description: Two former ministers from the Lula and Dilma governments, Aldo Rebelo and Roberto Mangabeira Unger, expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 runoff during a meeting in São Paulo. The discussion covered economy, the Amazon, and foreign policy, with no mention of position bargaining. The move highlights the shifting alliances amid electoral polarization.

item.title: MP Eleitoral aponta ligação de Canella com a milícia e pede ao TSE para negar registro da candidatura
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry has requested the TSE to reject Márcio Canella's candidacy for state deputy in Rio de Janeiro, alleging ties to militias and membership in a criminal organization. The lawmaker allegedly appointed militia leaders to positions in the city hall of Belford Roxo and is currently under investigation for organized crime.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula participa de caminhada em Copacabana
item.description: The president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), takes part in walks in two capitals: first in Rio de Janeiro at 10am at Posto 5 in Copacabana, then along Atlântica Avenue, and afterward in São Paulo at 4pm, with a gathering in front of Masp on Paulista Avenue, heading toward Haddock Lobo street. The activity is part of a social and political mobilization agenda.

item.title: Redes bolsonaristas espalhando o medo de olho na abstenção
item.description: Bolsonarist networks spread false claim that left-wing protesters will riot if Lula loses. The disinformation aims to discourage voting. Full article available for subscribers only.

item.title: 'Lula coloca Bolsonaro na defensiva': imprensa internacional destaca 'debate crucial' da TV Globo
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro on TV Globo drew international attention, with El País claiming Lula put his opponent on the defensive. The PT candidate took a more aggressive stance, while Flávio attempted to present himself as more moderate, particularly on social policies and public security.

item.title: MP Eleitoral diz que não cabe à Justiça decidir sobre sigilos de candidatos e defende extinção do caso
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry defended the dismissal of the case requesting the release of sigils of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing there is no strictly electoral matter involved. The deputy electoral attorney general Alexandre Espinosa stated there are no elements to justify the Electoral Justice intervention in the case.

item.title: Agenda do dia: Lula fecha campanha em São Paulo e Flávio vai ao Rio
item.description: On Saturday (October 24), Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) hold their final campaign rallies ahead of the 2026 presidential election second round. Street propaganda is allowed until 10 PM. Lula walks along Copacabana in the morning and rallies on Paulista Avenue in the afternoon, accompanied by allies such as Alckmin, Haddad, and Marina Silva. Flávio Bolsonaro campaigns in Belo Horizonte and then in Rio's Barra da Tijuca.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja onde o transporte público será gratuito no segundo turno e quais são as regras
item.description: Over 158.7 million voters will head to the polls in the 2026 second-round elections and can use free public transport in cities like Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, as per TSE Resolution No. 23.751/2026. While Rio offers free access to buses, metro, BRT, and VLT from 6 AM to 8 PM, São Paulo provides 24/7 free service with expanded lines. The benefit does not automatically apply to intercity or executive services.

item.title: Pazolini x Ferraço – Os números dos candidatos a governador do Espírito Santo (ES) no segundo turno das eleições 2026
item.description: Lorenzo Pazolini (Republicanos) and Ricardo Ferraço (MDB) are competing in the 2026 runoff election for governor of Espírito Santo. Pazolini leads with 49.65% of the votes in the first round; Ferraço received 34.06%. Both resigned from their positions to run for re-election.

item.title: Se vencer, Flávio Bolsonaro irá a Israel depois das eleições para pagar promessa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro promised to travel to Israel after the election runoff to fulfill a campaign commitment. The article, labeled as subscriber-exclusive, highlights the trip as one of the candidate's pledged actions. Full content is accessible via the article link with registration.

item.title: Presidente do TSE fará pronunciamento neste sábado
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, will deliver a nationwide broadcast on Saturday to remind voters to confirm their polling locations before the runoff. He will also note the reduced number of venue changes compared to 2022, emphasizing that such decisions are made by electoral zones, not the TSE.

item.title: Bruno Soller na Crusoé: O heroísmo que nasce da ameaça
item.description: The article examines how national security crises can reshape the Brazilian electoral dynamic, shifting focus from economic issues to territorial protection and the leader's defense. It uses Bruno Soller's 'Crusoé' narrative as metaphor for heroism emerging under external threats.

item.title: TSE manda retirar vídeo de suspeitos de tráfico com camisetas de Lula
item.description: The TSE ordered the removal of videos showing drug suspects wearing Lula campaign t-shirts, after reports that military police forced detainees to wear them in Piracicaba. The measure was taken at the request of the PT coalition, investigating possible misuse of the candidate's image.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 51,4% e Lula, 48,6%, dos votos válidos, aponta pesquisa do Instituto França
item.description: A survey by Instituto França shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (51.4% of valid votes) and Lula (48.6%) in the second round. Lula leads in the Northeast and among women, elderly voters, and low-income groups, while Bolsonaro leads in the Center-West, South, and Southeast regions.

item.title: Cadê a Michelle Bolsonaro? Senadora eleita 'some' da campanha de Flávio no segundo turno
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, former first lady and elected senator, avoided campaign events with Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, focusing on supporting Celina Leão in the Federal District. Out of 107 posts since July, only 5 emphasized the relative, according to a survey.

item.title: A operação de Lula para recuperar votos e virar Minas no 2º turno
item.description: Lula's campaign in Minas Gerais launched a targeted operation, mapping voter losses block by block to recover votes in the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, who leads by nearly five points. The strategy focuses on intensive grassroots actions like door-to-door outreach and walkabouts in key neighborhoods of Belo Horizonte with high recovery potential.

item.title: O impacto do debate da Globo: últimas pesquisas Datafolha e Quaest ouvem eleitores neste sábado
item.description: The Datafolha and Quaest polls released this Saturday show a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (46-45%) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (46-45%) within a two-point margin of error. The surveys captured partial impact of the TV Globo debate, comprising 4,050 and 3,702 interviews conducted Friday to Saturday.

item.title: O Brasil da segunda-feira
item.description: The text criticizes the deterioration of Brazil's democratic debate, highlighting the 'war of secrecy' and affective polarization that replaces political dialogue with existential confrontation. The author denounces 'cultural Jonism' and the burden of speeches that dehumanize opponents, reducing politics to exchanges of insults without focus on concrete proposals.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula citam informações falsas, exageradas e fora de contexto no debate da Globo
item.description: The TV Globo debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro featured imprecise claims verified by Agência Lupa and published by Folha during the debate.

item.title: Quem é Geraldo Alckmin, ex-rival que hoje é 'companheiro' e vice de Lula
item.description: Geraldo Alckmin, once a political rival of Lula in the 2006 elections, became his running mate in 2022 and is again the vice-presidential candidate in 2026. Previously adversaries, they joined forces to appeal to the center and financial markets. Alckmin plays a stabilizing and security role in the campaign.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula apanha para idade no debate na Globo
item.description: The article analyzes Lula's performance in the Globo electoral debate, highlighting difficulties attributed to advanced age, such as mental lapses, hoarse voice, and physical fatigue. Despite these criticisms, the content suggests a stance of journalists and commentators to avoid openly pointing out these aspects during the debate.

item.title: Lula está cansado e nervoso
item.description: The article highlights that Lula showed fatigue, irritation and confusion during the Globo debate, while Flávio Bolsonaro also displayed limitations. Despite the criticisms, the president was considered the winner of the clash, though the tone of the analysis is negative toward both candidates.

item.title: Joice Hasselmann: ‘Flávio é o pior dos Bolsonaro’
item.description: Joice Hasselmann labeled Flávio Bolsonaro as the worst of Jair Bolsonaro's children, claiming she knows the 'rot' of bolsonarism from within. In a livestream with André Janones, she stated she initially planned to nullify her vote but decided to support Lula after seeing Flávio with realistic chances of winning the 2026 elections. She called the PL candidate 'criminal' and expressed fear over the possibility of him becoming president.

item.title: Debate da Globo: Lula explora rejeição de Flávio, que tenta rotular petista como ultrapassado
item.description: In the Globo debate, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro adopted a more serious tone, with Lula highlighting criticisms of his opponent's background and Flávio attempting to portray the PT member as outdated. The debate was more policy-focused but retained tense moments, including criticism over remarks about 'nine fingers'.

item.title: Quem ganhou e quem perdeu no último debate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro?
item.description: The final debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, broadcast by TV Globo, was marked by fluctuating performances, with no clear consensus on who won. Some experts noted a slight edge for Lula in presentation, though Flávio holds a narrow lead in voting intentions ahead of Sunday's runoff.

item.title: TSE manda remover posts de detidos com camisetas de Lula
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court ordered the removal of posts linking the PT to criminality after a police operation in Piracicaba (SP), where detainees wore Lula's campaign shirts. The decision, issued by Minister Estela Aranha, responded to a request from the presidential coalition and set a 3-hour deadline for removal. Police investigate allegations that suspects were forced to wear the shirts.

item.title: Veja os memes do debate entre Lula e Flávio na “Globo”
item.description: The Globo debate between Lula and Flávio featured mutual criticisms, particularly over the pandemic and reliance on Google for information. Social media memes portrayed both candidates negatively, focusing on Lula's age and Flávio's alleged falsehoods.

item.title: A mudança na campanha de Lula no 2º turno: de 'ídolo' a candidato
item.description: Lula shifts from 'idol' to operational candidate with Camilo Santana and Rafael Fonteles leading his 2026 campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tenta sair pela tangente na ‘Globo’, mas também foi negacionista na pandemia
item.description: In a Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro attempted to downplay his role in pandemic denialism, yet his history shows alignment with anti-science rhetoric and promotion of unproven treatments. The health crisis exposed the Bolsonaro family's convergence with denialism, leading to tragic public health consequences.

item.title: Eleições 2026: segundo turno será neste domingo (25); veja o horário da votação
item.description: The second round of the 2026 elections takes place this Sunday (25th). In the presidential race, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) face off again. Voting runs from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Brasília time.

item.title: Dark horse, Vorcaro, Roberta Luchsinger, Willer Tomaz: entenda os ataques entre Flávio e Lula no debate da Globo
item.description: In the Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula traded accusations over scandals involving allies, including the Dark Horse case and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger. Both aimed to discredit each other through investigations and billionaire allegations.

item.title: Na eleição, o risco para a economia não é o ambientalismo
item.description: The 2026 election threatens the economy not through environmentalism but through regulatory instability and increasing judicialization, especially with proposals to change environmental legislation. Litigation in the economic sector has grown exponentially, creating uncertainty and impacting business planning.

item.title: MAPA: No 2º turno, Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro priorizam maiores colégios eleitorais e visitam mais de uma cidade por dia
item.description: In the runoff, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro focused their campaigns on São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro, often visiting multiple cities per day. Lula visited eight states and the Federal District, while Flávio covered nine states and the DF, targeting the Southeast region, home to 41.78% of voters.

item.title: Lula faz live com Janones e diz que “guerra vai ser ganha”
item.description: Lula held a live stream with André Janones after the Globo debate, where he declared that the 'war' against Flávio Bolsonaro will be won and thanked him for creating the 'Exército do Lula', a WhatsApp channel with 10 million followers used to mobilize supporters until the runoff.

item.title: Voto, sigilo e liberdade: do celular na cabine à prisão em período eleitoral
item.description: The incident of Romeu Zema filmed with a cell phone at the polling station revives debates on electoral rules. The arrest of voters is restricted between five days before the election and 48 hours after its closure, except in cases of flagrante delict, final conviction, or violation of safe conduct. Electoral crimes are judged by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Fator Mark Zuckerberg: o peso da Meta na eleição brasileira
item.description: Twelve Democratic members of the U.S. House of Representatives sent a letter to Mark Zuckerberg alleging that Meta intends to interfere in the 2026 Brazilian election in favor of Bolsonarismo, underscoring the role of digital platforms as political tools and concerns over foreign interference in Brazil's electoral process.

item.title: Jorginho diz que Lula está “cuspindo” e ameaça sair da 1ª fila
item.description: Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello (PL) said he would leave the front row of the TV Globo presidential debate because, according to him, President Lula (PT) was 'spitting' during the confrontation with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The debate, held on Friday (October 23, 2026), was the second direct encounter between the candidates; the first was on Band. Voting in the second round takes place on Sunday (October 25), from 8am to 5pm, Brasília time.

item.title: Bota pra Virar x Bloco do 22: Brasília vai "parar" na véspera da eleição
item.description: On the eve of the runoff election, Brasília will host two opposing protests — one from the left (Bota pra Virar) and one from the right (Bloco do 22) — scheduled at the same time and roughly two kilometers apart. The entire Esplanada dos Ministérios will be closed to traffic to ensure safety and prevent clashes. Politicians from various parties have confirmed attendance at both events.

item.title: Apoios e neutralidade: os possíveis rumos dos 9 milhões de votos da 3ª via
item.description: Third-way candidates received over 9 million votes, with Caiado and Zema endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro and Cury declaring vote after demanding governance without hatred. Renan Santos remained neutral, allowing free voting. Datafolha survey indicates no automatic vote transfer to Flávio, with only 40% migrating.

item.title: Conheça os planos econômicos de Lula e Flávio para os próximos anos
item.description: Lula and Flávio present opposing economic plans for Brazil, focusing on sustainable growth, public investments and social policies. Lula maintains the fiscal framework and prioritizes infrastructure, industry and income transfer programs, while Flávio proposes ministry cuts and a more liberal economy.

item.title: Canais de WhatsApp de Lula e Flávio mostram força do digital no 2º turno
item.description: The WhatsApp channels 'Exército do Lula' and 'Tropa do Flávio', led by André Janones and Nikolas Ferreira, highlighted the strength of digital communication in the 2026 runoff. The Lula channel, with over 10 million followers, faced legal disputes at the TSE, ending with a ruling requiring Meta to provide data on its coordinated activity.

item.title: Governo Lula ou Flávio: o que ambos defendem para a relação com os EUA
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro advocate different approaches toward the US, with the former prioritizing strategic autonomy and multilateral dialogue, while the latter seeks closer alignment with Donald Trump. Both will face the challenge of negotiating 37.5% tariffs imposed by the US on Brazilian goods, which affect 23.1% of exports to the country.

item.title: Lula divide verba de campanha entre rua e redes; Flávio foca no digital
item.description: Lula spread campaign funds across digital outreach, street rallies, and printed materials, while Flávio Bolsonaro focused primarily on digital strategies and social media. This difference reflects contrasting mobilization profiles and comfort with the online environment.

item.title: Por que o interior do Estado do Rio vota diferente da capital? Entenda
item.description: The 2026 elections highlighted the voting divergence between Rio de Janeiro's capital and its inland regions, where over 53% of voters outside the capital directly influenced outcomes, particularly in state legislative elections and the PL's strength. Candidates and parties intensified campaigns in inland municipalities, underscoring the strategic importance of areas such as São Gonçalo, Niterói, and the Lakes Region.

item.title: Flávio amplia propostas a dois dias da votação e anuncia medidas fora do plano de governo no debate da TV Globo
item.description: In his final debate before the runoff, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) expanded proposals beyond his government plan, adding e-sports to Student Games, harsher penalties for animal abuse, and investments in the National Cancer Institute. He also supported the Northeast Train connecting nine capitals, technical education with companies, and the revival of Student Games.
